_note: Verb pairs whose cells are identical or one letter apart, so a planner or reader can take one for the other. plan_warnings (pie/realize.py _default_warnings) warns when a realized form of one is identical to, or one letter away from, a primary form of the other. A general index over all usable verbs was measured first: identical forms across different roots warned on 1,150 of the 2,555 approved records (h₁ést 'was' = 'threw', bʰéh₂t 'spoke' = 'shone', ...). That is noise, not a check. So only pairs confirmed to have misled a plan are listed here.
